scripts.check:fonts: ! grep -rn --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' --include='*.css' 'font-bold\|font-semibold\|font-medium\|font-weight.*[56789][0-9][0-9]\|fontWeight.*[56789][0-9][0-9]' . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.next && echo 'Font weight check passed — no violations found.'
scripts.check:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:fonts
